# The Zizkian

A framework for readings that can lose. Version 0.2.0, experimental.
Prepared public home: https://maciejjankowski.com/zizkian/
Author: Maciej Jankowski.

The Prolog checker validates declarations and relationships in a reasoning
record. It does not verify source truth, consent or test quality. No finding is
valid. Authored attention weights are excluded from decision authority.
No controlled outcome benchmark is claimed.

- [Method](method.html)
- [Field guide and exercises](guide.html)
- [Checker contract](checker.html)
- [Evaluation and failure criteria](evaluation.html)
- [License scope](licensing.html)
- [License rationale and polemic](licensing-polemic.html)

No commercial license is offered by this public release. The standard terms
govern permissions. The licensing polemic is the project's ethical argument.
